options.content: The site itself, beside the networks: members and newsletter subscribers (Ghost's Admin API, kept per day by the bridge), visitors per day (Ghost's analytics), and every published post with its visitors, sign-ups and newsletter numbers. Read by the bridge ${every_ghost}; visitors need TINYBIRD_TOKEN in the postiz .env. Click a post for it up close, as with any social post. Where visitors and members come from is on [Growth](/d/puppi3-growth).
